conditional_win_rate: Use observed wins/discordances only where nonzero; else report undefined and no outcome depends on it at discordance0. Also simulate p=.85 and p=1 for comparison.
fixtures: per-stratum empirical rates: new measured agreement dev and historical unchanged-stratum dev
optimistic sensitivity: Wilson95 upper discordance endpoints in all answer strata, p=1; not a joint confidence bound or measured performance
no_redistribution: Do not spread agreement discordance uniformly into the four answer strata not changed by bank v5.
run_admission: Complete new dev result plus byte-identical offline replay required; no model calls
unchanged_strata_assumption: Historical dev replay used as plug-in; zero observed discordance is not population zero.
